connector.name: OpusClip by mindstone
connector.registryDescription: OpusClip MCP server - clip long-form videos, manage projects, collections, censor jobs, posts
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server-opus-video-clip. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mindstone account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
